reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis overstates the role of configurational entropy in stabilizing single-phase microstructures and ignores well-established strengthening and passivation mechanisms from secondary phases in lightweight HEAs, making it scientifically doubtful.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion based on comparing properties of homogenized versus deliberately aged samples.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is of little use because it sets up a straw-man comparison (homogeneous vs. inhomogeneous) that is unlikely to advance understanding of how to simultaneously optimize density, strength, and environmental resistance in these alloys.
